fit_reason: Whole car, 2018 MINI Cooper hardtop, listed by a private seller.
findings: Car appears freshly washed and still wet, with water drips under it, so the paint looks reasonably clean but not deeply glossy
Light dullness and water spotting visible on the hood and driver door in the side shot
Black plastic fender flares and rocker trim look slightly grayed and faded, especially on the front bumper lower lip
Headlight lenses show mild haze on the outer edges
Grime on the lower rear bumper around the exhaust and reflector area
No interior photos, so the interior can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the MINI Cooper. The paint looks pretty good, but the black fender trim is starting to fade and there's some water spotting on the hood and door that a polish and wax would clear up. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
